premises: A stepwise thermo-mechanical treatment can sequentially induce coherent δ-lamella and γ″ nanoprecipitates in a W-based refractory HEA.
This sequential precipitation enhances strength-ductility synergy by providing progressive strain hardening and delaying plastic instability.
The treated alloy achieves ~2.0 GPa yield strength and ~15% elongation at room temperature, and >1 GPa strength at 800 °C.
The improvement is relative to a conventional single-aged or single-phase W-based refractory HEA.
